topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, I'm happy to help out. I appreciate how much you put into your gardening, and having a little more space could make such a difference. I'll clear the area you mentioned and even add some compost to get it ready. We can plant those herbs you're excited about together, and maybe we can try some companion planting to keep the pests away naturally. It’s nice to see the yard come alive with all the green. I’ll look forward to lending a hand and learning from you, too.
